id.description: Stable plugin ID: a lowercase hyphenated UUIDv4 (8-4-4-4-12). Assigned once by scripts/asset_ids.py and never changed, even when the plugin moves or is renamed.

name.description: Kebab-case plugin identifier. Must match the plugin directory name.

displayName.description: Name shown in AWS Quick. A displayName on the plugin's catalog.json entry overrides it.

description.description: What the plugin does and who it is for.

name.description: Publisher name. Amazon, AWS, Amazon Web Services, or AWS Quick marks a first-party plugin; any other name marks a third-party plugin.

icon.description: Plugin-relative path to an SVG icon of at most 5 KB. Required for first-party plugins. An icon on the plugin's catalog.json entry overrides it.

kind.description: Plugin kind. A kind on the plugin's catalog.json entry overrides it.

categories.description: Other catalog categories to list the plugin under. Each must be a category in catalog.json.

skills.description: Skills the plugin installs, as <category>/<name> references to skills/<category>/<name>. Each skill must be published in the catalog.

connectors.description: The connector the plugin needs. At most one.

label.description: Name of the slot shown at install.

description.description: What the connector is used for.

types.description: Connector types that can fill the slot, for example SALESFORCE_CRM.
